summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repo code, as instructed. Nothing is committed.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs. Tabs owns state, keys, and the animation watcher. TabsRenderable does the width layout, label row, and underline bar. Clicks use @click metadata dispatched to action_range_clicked.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: clickable_ranges input before width; yields one Text with click spans last, in mapping order; the zero-width early path skips them.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: blended color is merged into each segment's existing style, preserving click metadata.
- Tests: new cases appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py (existing tests unchanged); new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (single ::: directive) and sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css.

Notes: the layout resolver's Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction with the specified defaults, so it was not changed. An empty label (cell width 0) becomes a flexible edge because the resolver treats size 0 as unset. Rich APIs (apply_meta, Style metadata merge) were relied on from existing repo usage and not verified against installed source. Tests have not been run; next step is running pytest on tests/renderables and tests/widgets, then the full suite.
